metadata.authority: Owner-authorized Stage 0 baseline, MPG-DEC-029 sequence and MPG-DEC-038 secondary allocation

secondaryCapabilityTrack.name: MPG Reputation / Review & Reputation Automation
secondaryCapabilityTrack.notes: Allocated secondary incubation/build WIP only; not service lifecycle ACTIVE, marketing approval or later-stage activation.

services.name: Professional Business Websites
services.description: A defined professional website service family currently undergoing capability, scope, delivery, commercial, and evidence readiness work.
services.targetCustomer: TBD through the Stage 1 customer and market decision process
prerequisites: Complete the website service readiness audit in docs/19-backlog.md.
Define offer boundaries, delivery process, QA, economics, capacity, and client experience.
Obtain suitable proof and explicit owner marketing approval before public release.

G1.notes: Customer segment and demand evidence remain to be established.

G2.notes: Capabilities are deliberately unassessed in the Stage 0 registry.

G3.notes: Delivery stack, accounts, reliability, and cost remain to be selected and verified.

G4.notes: Required delivery and commercial assets remain to be audited.

G5.notes: Scope boundaries and the delivery SOP are not yet accepted.

G6.notes: QA checklist and acceptance criteria remain to be proven.

G7.notes: No pricing or commercial terms are approved in Stage 0.

G8.notes: Discovery, onboarding, approvals, handover, and support remain to be designed.

G9.notes: Contract, privacy, accessibility, data, and insurance questions require review where relevant.

G10.notes: Fulfilment capacity and workload limits are unknown.

G11.notes: No proof is asserted by this baseline.

G12.notes: Partner needs, if any, must be determined before this gate can be marked not applicable.

G13.notes: Truthful offer language, audience, proof, assets, CTA, and owner approval are unresolved.

services.notes: Primary commercial build track. In development is not the same as available for sale.

services.name: Custom Business Systems
services.description: Custom software and business-system work retained as the second commercial productization priority.
prerequisites: Complete the Professional Business Websites productization track or obtain an explicit owner exception.

G7.notes: Custom systems must not be priced as simple websites.

services.notes: Planned only; not an active offer.

services.name: AI and Workflow Automation
services.description: Problem-led automation work retained as the third commercial productization priority, subject to reliability, security, fallback, monitoring, and ownership safeguards.
services.problem: TBD; vague AI transformation is not an acceptable offer definition
prerequisites: Define a reliable workflow, data/security controls, human fallback, monitoring, error handling, costs, ownership, and maintenance expectations.

G3.notes: Vendor reliability, access, and cost require assessment.

G5.notes: Human fallback, monitoring, and error handling are mandatory design questions.

G7.notes: Tool and maintenance costs remain unknown.

G8.notes: Client ownership, access, and maintenance expectations require definition.

G9.notes: Data and security review is required.

G12.notes: Vendor and specialist dependencies are unknown.

G13.notes: Claims must be specific and realistic.

services.notes: Planned only; not an active offer. Delivery mode describes the current intended governance model, not present capability.

services.name: Mobile Applications
services.description: A future mobile-application service family retained for structured capability and readiness assessment after the preceding BUILD priorities.
prerequisites: Complete the preceding BUILD productization priorities or obtain an explicit owner exception.
Assess mobile requirements, user experience, implementation, backend integration, testing, release, support, platform scope, tools, assets, and capacity.

G1.notes: Customer, problem, demand, and mobile use case remain TBD.

G2.notes: The broad owner declaration does not validate the required granular mobile capabilities.

G3.notes: Platforms, toolchain, accounts, licenses, reliability, and costs remain unknown.

G4.notes: Required devices, environments, reusable assets, and documentation remain unknown.

G5.notes: No mobile delivery process or supported-platform boundary is defined.

G6.notes: Device, platform, integration, release, and acceptance testing criteria remain undefined.

G7.notes: No pricing method, cost model, or commercial terms are approved.

G8.notes: Discovery, approvals, account ownership, release, handover, and support remain undefined.

G9.notes: Privacy, data, platform, store, accessibility, security, licensing, and jurisdiction questions require later review where applicable.

G10.notes: Implementation and support capacity are unassessed.

G11.notes: No mobile portfolio or delivery proof is asserted.

G12.notes: No partner need or partner readiness is asserted.

G13.notes: No mobile offer, claim language, proof, call to action, or marketing approval exists.

services.notes: Planned only. Not current WIP, evidence-validated, platform-defined, market-approved, or available for sale.

services.name: Digital Marketing
services.description: A future service family that must be decomposed into separately assessable strategy, creative, copy, organic, paid, tracking, analytics, SEO, and conversion capabilities.
prerequisites: Assess each material marketing capability separately; producing posts alone is not full-service marketing readiness.

G2.notes: Full-service claims require separately validated capabilities.

G9.notes: Advertising, privacy, tracking, and claims risks require review where applicable.

G11.notes: No results or client outcomes are asserted.

services.notes: Planned only; not an active offer.

services.name: Social Media Management
services.description: A future managed-service family requiring channel scope, content operations, approvals, moderation, measurement, capacity, and escalation controls.
prerequisites: Define exact channel, content, approval, community, reporting, access, and capacity boundaries.

G3.notes: Account security and scheduling/reporting tooling remain unknown.

G5.notes: Content approvals, moderation, and escalation need defined workflows.

G8.notes: Access, approvals, communication, and reporting expectations need definition.

G9.notes: Platform, content-rights, privacy, and advertising rules may apply.

G10.notes: Recurring content workload and response burden are unknown.

services.notes: Planned only; not an active offer.

services.name: Trade, Sourcing and Distribution
services.description: A long-term strategic capability family covering only accurately defined MPG roles and qualified partner-coordination models when prerequisites are eventually satisfied.
prerequisites: Assess sourcing and supplier-verification competence, jurisdiction requirements, payment and contract risk, insurance, commissions, representation agreements, and dispute handling.
Validate every required freight, customs, warehousing, supplier, legal, financial, or logistics relationship before relying on it.

G4.notes: Capital, documentation, insurance, and operational assets are unknown.

G5.notes: Supplier verification, payment, freight/customs coordination, disputes, and fallback processes require definition.

G7.notes: Commissions, partner costs, payment risk, margin, and capital needs are unknown.

G9.notes: Jurisdiction, licensing, customs, contract, insurance, and local-business requirements need qualified review.

G11.notes: No trade delivery proof is asserted.

G12.notes: No partner is listed or approved for delivery.

G13.notes: MPG must not imply it is a freight forwarder, customs broker, licensed importer, manufacturer representative, distributor, or shipping company without verified authority and capability.

services.notes: Long-term and planned only. The hybrid mode records anticipated dependency, not an existing partner relationship.
